name: Yareliz Candelario
education: Associate degree in Electrical Engineering Technology
bio: Yareliz is a non-binary Puerto Rican transit signal technician who starts their mornings with coffee, a faith podcast, and a quick check on whether their son remembered his lunch. Off the clock, they bounce between lifting sessions, experimenting with nail designs, and hunting down petite streetwear that actually fits without tailoring everything. They’re the kind of person who posts mushy anniversary captions for their spouse, then immediately follows it with a horror meme or a clip from WWE. A surprising side hobby: they keep a notebook of field recordings from subway platforms and backyard grills to turn into drum textures for late-night beatmaking.
